briefdescription.para: Defines a handler that an application defines to communicate with the interrupt system to retrieve state information about an application.

briefdescription.para: Looks up the device configuration based on the unique device ID or base address.

detaileddescription.para: The XUartPs_ConfigTable[] contains the configuration info for each device in the system.

simplesect.para: A pointer to the configuration found or NULL if the specified device ID/BaseAddress was not found. See xuartps.h for the definition of XUartPs_Config.
In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.

briefdescription.para: Initializes a specific XUartPs instance so it is ready for use.

detaileddescription.para: The data format of the device is setup for 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, and no parity by default. The baud rate is set to a default value specified by Config->DefaultBaudRate if set, otherwise it is set to 19.2K baud. The receive FIFO threshold is set for 8 bytes. The default operating mode of the driver is polled mode.

parameterdescription.para: Reference to a structure containing information about a specific XUartPs driver.

Device base address in the virtual memory address space. The caller is responsible for keeping the address mapping from EffectiveAddr to the device physical base address unchanged once this function is invoked. Unexpected errors may occur if the address mapping changes after this function is called. If address translation is not used, pass in the physical address instead.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if initialization was successful.
XST_UART_BAUD_ERROR if the baud rate is not possible because the inputclock frequency is not divisible with an acceptable amount of error.

simplesect.para: The default configuration for the UART after initialization is:

listitem.para: 19,200 bps or XPAR_DFT_BAUDRATE if defined
8 data bits
1 stop bit
no parity
FIFO's are enabled with a receive threshold of 8 bytes
The RX timeout is enabled with a timeout of 1 (4 char times)
All interrupts are disabled.

briefdescription.para: Sends the specified buffer in polled or interrupt driven mode.

detaileddescription.para: This function is non-blocking. If the device is busy sending data, it returns and indicates zero bytes were sent. Otherwise, it fills the TX FIFO as much as it can, and returns the number of bytes sent.
In polled mode, this function only sends as much data as the TX FIFO can buffer. The application may need to call it repeatedly to send the entire buffer.

In interrupt mode, this function starts sending the specified buffer, then the interrupt handler continues sending data until the entire buffer has been sent. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of sending.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer of data to send.
Number of bytes to send. A value of zero stops a previous send operation that is in progress in interrupt mode. Any data that was already put into the transmit FIFO is sent.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes actually sent.
The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Receives a specified number of bytes of data from the device.

detaileddescription.para: Attempts to receive data and store it into the specified buffer. Works for both polled or interrupt driven modes. This function is non-blocking.

In polled mode, this function only receives the data already in the RX FIFO. The application may need to call it repeatedly to receive the entire buffer. Polled mode is the default mode of operation for the device.

In interrupt mode, this function starts the receiving. If not the entire buffer has been received, the interrupt handler continues receiving data until the entire buffer has been received. A callback function, as specified by the application, is called to indicate the completion of the receiving or error conditions.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to buffer to receive data into.
Number of bytes to receive. A value of zero stops a previous receive operation that is in progress in interrupt mode.

simplesect.para: The number of bytes received.
The number of bytes is not asserted so that this function may be called with a value of zero to stop an operation that is already in progress.

briefdescription.para: Sets the baud rate for the device.

detaileddescription.para: Checks the input value for validity and also verifies that the requested rate can be configured to within the maximum error range specified by XUARTPS_MAX_BAUD_ERROR_RATE. If the provided rate is not possible, the current setting is unchanged.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if everything configured as expected.
XST_UART_BAUD_ERROR if the requested rate is not available because there was too much error.

briefdescription.para: Sets the options for the specified driver instance.

detaileddescription.para: The options are implemented as bit masks such that multiple options may be enabled or disabled simultaneously.

The GetOptions function may be called to retrieve the currently enabled options. The result is ORed in the desired new settings to be enabled and ANDed with the inverse to clear the settings to be disabled. The resulting value is then used as the options for the SetOption function call.

parameterdescription.para: Options to set which are bit masks contained in the file xuartps.h and named XUARTPS_OPTION_*.

briefdescription.para: Gets the options for the specified driver instance.

detaileddescription.para: The options are implemented as bit masks such that multiple options may be enabled or disabled simultaneously.

simplesect.para: The current options for the UART. The options are bit masks that are contained in the file xuartps.h and named XUARTPS_OPTION_*.

briefdescription.para: Sets the receive FIFO trigger level.

detaileddescription.para: The receive trigger level specifies the number of bytes in the receive FIFO that cause a receive data event (interrupt) to be generated.

briefdescription.para: Gets the receive FIFO trigger level.

detaileddescription.para: The receive trigger level indicates the number of bytes in the receive FIFO that cause a receive data event (interrupt) to be generated.

simplesect.para: The current receive FIFO trigger level. This is a value from 0-31.

briefdescription.para: Gets the modem status from the specified UART.

detaileddescription.para: The modem status indicates any changes of the modem signals. This function allows the modem status to be read in a polled mode. The modem status is updated whenever it is read such that reading it twice may not yield the same results.

simplesect.para: The modem status which are bit masks that are contained in the file xuartps.h and named XUARTPS_MODEM_*.
The bit masks used for the modem status are the exact bits of the modem status register with no abstraction.

briefdescription.para: Determines if the specified UART is sending data.

listitem.para: TRUE if the UART is sending data.
FALSE if UART is not sending data.

briefdescription.para: Gets the operational mode of the UART.

detaileddescription.para: The UART can operate in one of four modes: Normal, Local Loopback, Remote Loopback, or automatic echo.

simplesect.para: The operational mode is specified by constants defined in xuartps.h. The constants are named XUARTPS_OPER_MODE_*.

briefdescription.para: Sets the operational mode of the UART.

detaileddescription.para: The UART can operate in one of four modes: Normal, Local Loopback, Remote Loopback, or automatic echo.
0 - 3: Flow delay inactive. 4 - 32: If Flow Control mode is enabled, UART_rtsN is deactivated when the receive FIFO fills to this level.

simplesect.para: The Flow Delay is specified by constants defined in xuartps_hw.h. The constants are named XUARTPS_FLOWDEL*.

detaileddescription.para: 0 - 3: Flow delay inactive. 4 - 63: If Flow Control mode is enabled, UART_rtsN is deactivated when the receive FIFO fills to this level.

briefdescription.para: Gets the Receive Timeout of the UART.

simplesect.para: The current setting for receive time out.

briefdescription.para: Sets the Receive Timeout of the UART.

parameterdescription.para: Setting that allows the UART to detect an idle connection on the receiver data line. Timeout duration = RecvTimeout x 4 x Bit Period. 0 disables the timeout function.

briefdescription.para: Sets the data format for the device.

detaileddescription.para: The data format includes the baud rate, number of data bits, number of stop bits, and parity. It is the caller's responsibility to ensure that the UART is not sending or receiving data when this function is called.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a format structure containing the data format to be set.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the data format was successfully set.
XST_UART_BAUD_ERROR indicates the baud rate could not be set because of the amount of error with the baud rate and the input clock frequency.
XST_INVALID_PARAM if one of the parameters was not valid.

simplesect.para: The data types in the format type, data bits and parity, are 32 bit fields to prevent a compiler warning. The asserts in this function cause a warning if these fields are bytes.

briefdescription.para: Gets the data format for the specified UART.

detaileddescription.para: The data format includes the baud rate, number of data bits, number of stop bits, and parity.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a format structure that contains the data format after this call completes.

simplesect.para: The current interrupt mask. The mask indicates which interrupts are enabled.

parameterdescription.para: Interrupts to enable or disable. A '1' enables an interrupt, and a '0' disables.

briefdescription.para: Handles interrupts for the XUartPs driver.

detaileddescription.para: Must be connected to an interrupt system by the application such that it can be called when an interrupt occurs.

briefdescription.para: Sets the handler for an event that needs the application's attention.

detaileddescription.para: The driver calls the handler when an event (interrupt) occurs.

parameterdescription.para: Upper layer callback reference passed back when the callback function is invoked.

simplesect.para: There is no assert on the CallBackRef since the driver does not know what it is (nor should it)

briefdescription.para: Runs a self-test on the driver and hardware device.

detaileddescription.para: Performs a local loopback and verifies data can be sent and received. The time for this test is proportional to the baud rate that has been set prior to calling this function.
The mode and control registers are restored before return.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if the test was successful.
XST_UART_TEST_FAIL if the test failed looping back the data.

simplesect.para: This function can hang if the hardware is not functioning properly.
